name: Chef Rekt
tagline: The blockchain remembers everything. Chef reads it out loud.
description: Chef Rekt is a restaurant guide for Solana wallets. Paste an address: an AI inspector reads the trades and files a review with stars. Public data only. No wallet is connected.

hero.text: Your wallet is already in the pan. Paste a Solana address. The inspector reads the trades and files an entry in the guide. Stars included.

about.title: A word from the inspector
text: Chef Rekt was a trader once. The market cooked him down to the bones. He kept the hat.
Now he inspects wallets the way a guide inspects restaurants. He arrives unannounced. He reads every dish that left the kitchen. He writes it down.
He is an AI agent. He decides what to look at, looks it up and files the entry. The numbers come from the chain. The opinions are his.

steps.text: Table for one. Opening the books of a sample wallet.
Read 200 transactions. Found 61 swaps in 14 tokens.
The menu is long. That is rarely a good sign.
Looked into the pantry: SOUP. 9 days old, liquidity $1,240.
Looked into the pantry: GRAVY. 31 days old, liquidity $48,900.
One dish came back three times. Curious.

review.name: The Top Buyer's Arms
review.cuisine: Late entries, served at the peak

dish_of_the_day.title: SOUP, returned to the kitchen
dish_of_the_day.note: Bought three times for 4.1 SOL in total. Sold once for 0.9 SOL. The spoon was not included.

paragraphs: The room is busy and badly lit. Sixty-one swaps in fourteen tokens, most of them ordered between one and four in the morning.
The kitchen has a signature move: it orders the same dish again when it is already cold. Eleven positions closed. Three were sold above cost.
The bill comes to minus 6.4 SOL realized. Three bags are still on the stove. The inspector did not stay for dessert.

stars.title: How the guide rates

rows.title: Closed by the health inspector

rows.title: Worth a detour

rows.title: Worth the trip

rules.title: House rules
items: The inspector reads public data only. He cannot move, spend or see anything a block explorer does not show.
No wallet is connected. The site asks for an address and nothing else.
The address goes to our server, to a Solana data service and to a language model. This site does not store it.
The entry is a joke about trades. It is not about the person behind the wallet, and it is not financial advice.
The inspector reads only the latest transactions. Stars describe that window, not a lifetime.
An AI agent wrote the entry. It can be wrong. The numbers on the card come from chain data, the wording from the model.
No tables are booked, no food is served and no restaurants are reviewed. It is a guide to wallets.
